title: Andrew Kelley: A Practical Guide to Applying Data Oriented Design (DoD)
summary: Andrew Kelley, creator of Zig, presents practical data-oriented design techniques for shrinking memory footprint and making programs cache friendly. He ends with a case study of how these ideas sped up the Zig compiler.
why: HN cites it as one of the best talks on data-oriented design, applying struct-of-arrays and compact data layouts to a real compiler.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: A good introduction to SoA (for anyone curious) are the two most famous Data-Oriented Design talks
